refinements.name: 寻经定络
refinements.description: 装备者的[强化特殊技]和[终结技]造成的伤害增加25%；队伍中任意角色受到伤害或回复生命时，为装备者回复2点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's EX Special Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 25%. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

refinements.name: 寻经定络
refinements.description: 装备者的[强化特殊技]和[终结技]造成的伤害增加28.7%；队伍中任意角色受到伤害或回复生命时，为装备者回复2.3点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's EX Special Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 28.7%. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains 2.3 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

refinements.name: 寻经定络
refinements.description: 装备者的[强化特殊技]和[终结技]造成的伤害增加32.5%；队伍中任意角色受到伤害或回复生命时，为装备者回复2.6点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's EX Special Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 32.5%. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains 2.6 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

refinements.name: 寻经定络
refinements.description: 装备者的[强化特殊技]和[终结技]造成的伤害增加36.2%；队伍中任意角色受到伤害或回复生命时，为装备者回复2.9点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's EX Special Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 36.2%. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains 2.9 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

refinements.name: 寻经定络
refinements.description: 装备者的[强化特殊技]和[终结技]造成的伤害增加40%；队伍中任意角色受到伤害或回复生命时，为装备者回复3.2点能量，5秒内最多触发一次；
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's EX Special Attack and Ultimate DMG increases by 40%. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains 3.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：极意连打
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的体术攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive melee attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：爆音点穴指
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前释放体术并丢出鞭炮，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]向前方进行强力打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时将获得3点[破劲]，当招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
通过此次[快速支援]上场的代理人将会获得核心被动提供的贯穿力加成，潘引壶会在换人后留在场上自动释放[特殊技：断脉破穴手]直至[破劲]耗尽后下场；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：移峰倒海
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动体术攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：锅气灌顶
chain.nameEn: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
坐上[铁锅]快速旋转冲撞，对路径上敌人造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：满汉全席！
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
施展术法将气劲凝作炒饭掀出，对敌人造成大量物理伤害，为全队角色回复160点生命值，并为全队角色施加8秒持续回复生命值的效果，每秒回复0.85%生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Physical DMG and healing all squad members for 160 HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering 0.85% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：抬头见喜
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动体术攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：见敌卸甲
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：借势打势
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:

facts.text: 招式发动时将获得3点[破劲]，当招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.

facts.text: 潘引壶发动[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]命中敌人触发[快速支援]的一段时间内，通过[快速支援]或[连携技]入场的下一位代理人将会获得[通窍]效果。该效果提供潘引壶初始攻击力9%的贯穿力提升，持续25秒。该效果提供的贯穿力最多不超过540点。
facts.textEn: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 9% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

facts.text: 潘引壶发动[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]命中敌人触发[快速支援]的一段时间内，通过[快速支援]或[连携技]入场的下一位代理人将会获得[通窍]效果。该效果提供潘引壶初始攻击力18%的贯穿力提升，持续25秒。该效果提供的贯穿力最多不超过540点。
facts.textEn: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 18% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

cinema.name: 气劲护体
cinema.description: 所有单位对被施加[气绝]效果的敌人造成伤害时，造成的伤害额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.

cinema.name: 云岿点穴手
cinema.description: 每消耗6点[破劲]，潘引壶将回复4点能量，[特殊技：断脉破穴手]命中敌人时对敌人造成的[气绝]效果将提升至12秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

cinema.name: 经外奇穴
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 特等上厨
cinema.description: [终结技：满汉全席！]为全队角色回复生命时，生命回复效果提升25%，持续回复效果的生命回复效果提升25%；发动[终结技：满汉全席！]时获得[储粮]效果，当队伍内任意角色损失生命值时，消耗[储粮]效果为其回复[终结技：满汉全席！]即时回复生命值50%的生命值，该效果不可叠加。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.

cinema.name: 「稀人」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 气穴论
cinema.description: [核心被动：脉中乾坤]提供的[通窍]将额外获得潘引壶初始攻击力6%的提升，该效果提供的贯穿力最多提升至720点。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.

ex.descriptionEn:

Special Attack: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Special Attack: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force.

142100004.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
142100004.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
142100004.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]向前方进行强力打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时将获得3点[破劲]，当招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
通过此次[快速支援]上场的代理人将会获得核心被动提供的贯穿力加成，潘引壶会在换人后留在场上自动释放[特殊技：断脉破穴手]直至[破劲]耗尽后下场；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
142100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1421-core-12.name: 核心被动：脉中乾坤
1421-core-12.description: 潘引壶发动[强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠]命中敌人触发[快速支援]的一段时间内，通过[快速支援]或[连携技]入场的下一位代理人将会获得[通窍]效果。该效果提供潘引壶初始攻击力9%的贯穿力提升，持续25秒。该效果提供的贯穿力最多不超过540点。
1421-core-12.descriptionEn: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 9% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.
